title: A new flavanone and other constituents from the rhizomes of Polygonum amplexicaule var. sinense and their effect on osteoblastic MC3T3-E1 cells
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,40021-40029
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04691B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Xi-peng Li, Ying-zhou Fu, Bin Li, Jun-yu Chen, Yu-xia Zhang, Wen-lei Wang, Jing-yuan Guo, Gen-yun Tang
The phytochemical investigation of the extract from the rhizomes of Polygonum amplexicaule led to the isolation of thirty compounds, including a new flavanone. The proliferation, differentiation, and mineralizaton activity were tested.
